tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of the Service Provider in the Format at Annexure A
Attested copy of the Agency Registration, Provident Fund and ESI, GST Registration certificate and PAN Registration.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Provident Fund and ESI, GST and PAN Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should Submit the Certificate/License of Experience in minimum 1 year running coaching center in Karnataka Only.

The company/firm should have been in the business of providing services for last five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) Details of past performance on services of 50% similar nature executed by the Service Provider.

Certificate certified by Chartered Accountant for the Annual Turnover of Rs. 10.00 Lakhs relating to providing outsource personnel for the each of the last five audited financial years i.e., (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2025-26) Minimum 2 years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 3.00 lakhs (Credit lines/Letters of Credit / Certificates from any Nationalized Banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (Usually 30% of the amount of contract).
Service Provider should submit written document regarding facilitate Branch/Main office in Ramanagara city limit with in 30 days from the date of awarding contract.
Anti-collusion and self-declaration certificate regarding not blacklisted by any firm/ Government agencies in the format set out in Appendix G and G1

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate Audited by CA and Mentioning UDIN Number
